invariant:
`UniqueScopeSchema` is the closed scope vocabulary `boolean | 'global' | 'organization'` (ADR-0120 D1). `'organization'` is the explicit synonym of field-level `true` — identical materialization, and `isUniqueDeclared` MUST count it (a word the vocabulary accepts but no driver reads is declarable-but-inert, ADR-0078). `'tenant'` and `'org'` are rejected, never aliased — the parse error names `'organization'` (§Terminology; PD #12: one contract, no dialects). The single-tenant story is D3's NULL-safe COALESCE bucket, NOT the retired 'composite degenerates to single-column' claim #5030 falsified.

ADR-0144 D2 — `CurrencyConfigSchema` has a third mode, `record`: the amount stays a bare number (ADR-0104 D1) and `currencyField` names the sibling field holding each record's ISO 4217 code. The config door (`refuseRecordModeKeyMismatch`) requires a non-empty `currencyField` under `record`, refuses it under `dynamic` / `fixed`, and refuses `defaultCurrency` under `record`. Each refused key would be declared but read by nothing (ADR-0078). Do NOT give `record` a `defaultCurrency` fallback or a platform-chosen code field name: per D8 rules 2 and 4, the code is the record's own, the field is the author's, and nothing fills either in. What the pointer NAMES is judged on the object (object.zod.ts), not here.

ADR-0144 D5 — `currencyConfig.homeAmount: { field, rateDate, rateField }` is read only under `record` (`refuseRecordModeKeyMismatch` refuses it under `dynamic` / `fixed`), and all three pointers are REQUIRED whenever it is declared, each non-empty (`HomeAmountSchema`, a closed shape). Do NOT make `rateField` or `rateDate` optional, and do NOT give either a default (`created_at`, an injected `AMOUNT_rate` column): D1 stores the home amount "with the rate used" and D8 rule 2 lets that rate and the document date live only in author-declared fields named by pointer. What the pointers NAME is judged on the object (object.zod.ts), not here.
